'''Esorr Kayin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of a member of the [[Dark Council]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
He [[Death/Legends|murdered]] the [[Necus's apprentice|apprentice]] of Lord [[Necus]] in the second-floor library of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], and the deed was witnessed by another acolyte named [[Alif]], who Kayin threatened into remaining silent. However, Alif was later interrogated and the culprit's name revealed; Inquisitor [[Zyn]] was unable to punish Kayin on account of his master's status as a Dark Council member, though Necus himself intended to exact retribution.

==Behind the scenes==
Kayin's first name is the subject of some confusion. Both Zyn and Alif spell it as "Esorr," but the messages received by the Sith Inquisitor player spell it "Essor."
